# ui::TextEffect

Header: `winui/render/Text.hpp`.

A multi-pass text effect carried by [TextStyle::effect](text-style.md#effect); the classic themes use it for the engraved disabled-button label. The run's own color is ignored while an effect is active: the renderer draws `highlight` at (`offset_x`, `offset_y`) first, then `shadow` on the origin. Measuring is unaffected.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::TextStyle style;
style.effect = ui::TextEffect{ui::TextEffectKind::Emboss, ui::colors::White,
                                 ui::Color::from_argb(0xFF808080), 1.0f, 1.0f};
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `TextEffectKind` | `TextEffectKind::None` | Which effect to apply; None disables the extra pass entirely. |
| `highlight` | `Color` | `colors::White` | [Color](../core/color.md) of the offset raised pass, the classic 3D highlight color. |
| `shadow` | `Color` | `colors::Black` | [Color](../core/color.md) of the base pass on the origin, the classic 3D shadow color. |
| `offset_x` | `float` | `1.0f` | Horizontal offset of the highlight pass, in DIPs. |
| `offset_y` | `float` | `1.0f` | Vertical offset of the highlight pass, in DIPs. |
